g.text: A tiny service, here so the documentation's recordings have something to
page through, pick from and search. Nothing in it runs.
orbit watches a queue, hands each
to a worker and reports progress in the
terminal. Workers are plain functions; the scheduler decides how many run at
that fails, and gives up after three tries.
